description: React component 'SmartViews' manages the display and interactions for smart views within a preferences UI. It handles rendering, state management, and modal dialogs for creating and editing smart views.

classes.name: AddSmartViewModalController
classes.description: Controller managing the state and logic for the 'Add Smart View' modal.

classes.name: EditSmartViewModalController
classes.description: Controller managing the state and logic for the 'Edit Smart View' modal.

methods.name: setIsAddingSmartView
methods.description: Sets the state to show the AddSmartView modal.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the current view in the EditSmartViewModalController.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the edit smart view modal.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the add smart view modal.
